'''Commando Team Seven''' was a unit of [[Commando/Legends|Commandos]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Republic Military/Legends|military]]. They served on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] around [[3643 BBY]] under the command of [[Republic Strategic Information Service|SIS]] [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Weller]] and were tasked with disarming a series of bombs across the [[Tularan Marsh]].

These bombs had been provided to Taris street gangs prior to the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Orbital bombardment|bombardment]] of the planet to aid in their resistance against the occupation. While much of the planet didn't survive, the bombs did. Commando Team Seven however was not able to accomplish their mission as all five members were killed by [[Rakghoul]]s, resulting in Agent Weller recruiting a Republic spacer to finish the mission.<ref name="Future Threat" />
